title: Bitget Demo order rejected by venue (40774) — order placement never proven live
expected: POST /api/v2/mix/order/place-order returns code 0 with a venue orderId for a minimal 0.001 BTCUSDT Demo order

root_cause: CONFIRMED: the Bitget Demo futures account is in hedge_mode (posMode=hedge_mode), and Bitget v2 futures accounts default to hedge mode. The one-way request body (no tradeSide) was rejected with 40774. Fix: OrderDispatcher takes an explicit positionMode and sends tradeSide:'open' in hedge mode, omitted in one-way mode. Confirmed by the venue's own order-detail posMode field.
closure_condition: Dispatcher request body carries the position-mode field required for one-way Demo accounts
A single explicitly-authorized Demo order returns venue code 0 with a non-empty orderId
Order read-back confirms a real venue status (NEW / PARTIALLY_FILLED / FILLED)
resolution: Added BitgetPositionMode to OrderDispatcher (commit 543656c30f1b6b7239e7c3e85e573832b0c7c32b). Regression guard packages/engine/test/dispatcher-position-mode.test.ts asserts the two request bodies differ in exactly one field (tradeSide). Second bounded Demo order accepted, filled and read back.

title: FRIDAY_CLOSE_SNAPSHOT is 43.6% stale and an implicit fallback risk for Demo/live decisions
expected: A stale benchmark prevents execution rather than trading against a frozen price
observed: REPRODUCED: the GAP-015 freshness control existed and was unit-tested but was NOT called anywhere in the packet decision path (assertBenchmarkUsableForTrading had zero call sites outside its own test). The pre-flight hardcoded hoursToClose:1 and treated a successful MCP fetch as 'fresh' even though equity_price_quote publishes NO timestamp, so freshness was unverifiable. The control is now wired into buildPacket BEFORE Quant Boy and fails closed; assessed via assessBenchmarkFreshness which distinguishes sourceAsOf from fetchedAt. NOT E2E_VERIFIED: no tradable benchmark source with a trustworthy timestamp has been found yet, so every live run blocks.
root_cause: The snapshot is an offline test fixture that drifted far from the market, and there was no deterministic staleness gate.
closure_condition: live MCP/official benchmark is the required source for live/demo decisions
LOCAL_SNAPSHOT refused for any live/demo trading decision
a maximum benchmark age is enforced deterministically
stale or unparseable asOf produces a deterministic veto path carrying machine-readable evidence

blocked_by: No benchmark source with a trustworthy upstream timestamp is available yet (GAP-018)
resolution: market-regime.ts adds assessBenchmarkFreshness/assertBenchmarkProvable and a regime-aware resolver; buildPacket gates on it before Quant runs, leaving quant null and non-executable when freshness is unverifiable. 35 regime/freshness tests plus 10 packet-path tests. Real-world proof that it blocks: the 2026-09-30 daily run returned STRATEGY_EVALUATED_NO_ACTION with freshness=unverifiable and quantEvaluated=false.

title: No benchmark source publishes a trustworthy timestamp, so freshness cannot be proven for any live run
expected: A benchmark source whose own as-of timestamp can be read, so freshness is provable
observed: AUDITED 2026-09-30: all 22 free-tier Bitget MCP equity entries enumerated and the price-shaped candidates probed. NONE publishes a per-quote as-of timestamp. equity_price_quote returns symbol/last_price/open/high/low/close/prev_close/volume and derived ratios, with ZERO time-like fields. equity_price_historical returns status_code 204 with empty data even when given explicit start_time/end_time. equity_calendar exposes a 'time' field but it is a static company profile epoch (1769212800000 = 2026-01-24), not a quote timestamp, alongside 'is_trading_time' which is a session label ('after hours') rather than an instant. equity_fundamental_ratios/estimates_census expose 'time'/scraped_date fields tied to fiscal periods, not live prices. The only timestamp anywhere is the MCP RESPONSE ENVELOPE 'timestamp', which records when Money Boys queried the proxy, not when the underlying price formed. Using it would be exactly the synthesized freshness this control exists to prevent.
root_cause: The available free-tier MCP equity surface provides prices without a per-instrument as-of timestamp. No candidate supplies an independently meaningful sourceAsOf.
closure_condition: A documented benchmark source publishes a parseable as-of timestamp
assessBenchmarkFreshness returns verified_fresh from that real source
A live run reaches Quant evaluation rather than blocking at the benchmark gate
blocked_by: No timestamped benchmark source is available through the current authenticated or free-tier surface. Requires one of: (a) a different MCP data_tier or entry that publishes a per-quote as-of, (b) a direct market-data venue feed with explicit timestamps, (c) a licensed equity quote source with published as-of semantics, or (d) an operator-supplied reference price with an operator-asserted as-of timestamp recorded as provenance.
